name: Sheathed pondweed
desc: Sheathed pondweed (Stuckenia vaginata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Stuckenia vaginata, commonly called sheathed pondweed, big sheathed pondweed or large-sheathed pondweed is a water plant species that grows in fresh and brackish water in Europe, Northern Asia…
